sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the filter key. Valid values:
- AgenticSpaceIds

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The value of the filter key. Wildcards are not supported.
- AgenticSpaceIds: Only a single ID can be specified.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of results per query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned in the previous API call.
